fusions.name: Fetched Back
fusions.desc: Throws the blade at the first enemy within 8 tiles, where it deals 8 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Pack Signal
fusions.desc: A first-blood cut that deals 26 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Harried Flank
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds. For the first 7 seconds, a hound escort strikes your enemies for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Heel and Hold
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
